mapper.select: SELECT category_id AS categoryId, academy_id AS academyId, category_type AS categoryType, category_name AS categoryName, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM exam_categories WHERE category_type = #{categoryType} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, category_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_categories (academy_id, category_type, category_name, sort_order) VALUES (#{academyId}, #{categoryType}, #{categoryName}, #{sortOrder})
